records.text: A Vile Fin shredder is a humanoid who can cast Shred in combat.
Vile Fin Tidehunters wield frost magic: they cast Frost Nova in combat and can cast Quick Frost Ward when an ally is injured.
A Moonrage Darkrunner voices the Sons of Arugal’s defiance, warning that the faction will rise against anyone who challenges the Moonrage’s power.
A Rot Hide Gladerunner snarls at passersby and speaks of fresh meat and bones to gnaw, marking it as a hostile predator. It is also associated with the Rot Hide group’s combat magic.
A Rot Hide Mystic snarls about fresh meat and bones. In a fight, it can cast Healing Wave when an ally is injured.
A ferocious grizzled bear prowls the forests and surrounding areas of Silverpine. It fights with a powerful attack when engaged.
A Moonrage Glutton prowls Silverpine and nearby areas. Its name associates it with the Moonrage, and it uses a combat ability when fighting.
A Moss Stalker inhabits parts of Silverpine and nearby areas. It can unleash a spell when wounded in combat.
Mist Creepers are creatures found around northern Silverpine Forest. They attack with poison.
Moonrage Darksouls are hostile, enraged creatures of Silverpine Forest. Their combat behavior includes becoming enraged and using a spell as their health falls.
Giant Grizzled Bears are large bears found across Silverpine Forest. They use a combat ability when fighting.
Ravenclaw Raiders are hostile raiders found in Silverpine Forest. They fight with cursed blades.
Ravenclaw Slaves are enslaved figures found in Silverpine Forest. In combat, they use an ability named Shared Bondage.
Dalaran Apprentices are frost mages who protect themselves with Frost Armor, attack with Frostbolt, and may flee to seek help when badly hurt.
A Ravenclaw servant in the surrounding countryside. It uses Curse of Agony and Soul Siphon in combat.
A Ravenclaw champion encountered in the surrounding countryside.
A Hand of Ravenclaw encountered in the countryside, using Touch of Ravenclaw in combat.
A Dalaran watcher found around Dalaran.
A Dalaran wizard who maintains Frost Armor outside combat.
A Pyrewood watcher.
A Pyrewood sentry.
Known as a Pyrewood Elder, this figure is associated with the Pyrewood community in Silverpine Forest.
A Vile Fin Oracle is a spellcasting member of the murloc communities found around Silverpine Forest. In a fight, this oracle uses Shock, giving its role a clear magical edge among the Vile Fin.
A Vile Fin Lakestalker belongs to the murloc communities around Silverpine Forest and nearby waters. It casts Healing Ward both in combat and while out of combat.

A Dalaran Protector serves among Dalaran’s armed presence in the region. The protector can summon a Dalaran Serpent in combat, a distinctive part of its defense alongside the warders and mages stationed nearby.

A Dalaran Warder is one of the armed Dalaran figures in the region, serving alongside protectors and mages. Like the protector, the warder can summon a Dalaran Serpent in combat; the title marks a distinct watchful role within that force.
A Dalaran Mage is part of Dalaran’s presence in the region, alongside its protectors and warders. In combat, this mage casts Fireball, bringing direct offensive spellcraft to the group’s defense.
A Dalaran conjuror practices destructive and demonic magic, warding themself with Demon Skin, summoning a voidwalker, and attacking with Shadow Bolt. When badly hurt, they flee for help.
A Dalaran spellscribe is a formidable frost-magic practitioner, shielding themself with Frost Armor and attacking with Frostbolt. Their title and combat magic distinguish them among Dalaran's mages.
The Moonrage Bloodhowler is a hostile combatant who attacks with a powerful bite.

Apothecary Renferrel, of the Royal Apothecary Society, studies unusual substances and develops potions in Silverpine. His investigations include the Rot Hide ichor, whose components point to warlock and necromantic magic, and toxic wolf-heart samples he considers worth further study. He shares findings with colleagues and can concoct a potion; the failures of the Deathstalkers trouble him.

Dalar Dawnweaver is a Silverpine researcher determined to understand and undo Arugal's enchantments. He studies the shackles used to strengthen Arugal's magic and the transformation of Pyrewood's villagers into worgen at night. Though he scorns Arugal's competence, Dalar regards the wizard's curse as a danger to the Forsaken's plans for the region and works with the player to counter it.
A Rot Hide Brute is an undead creature that snarls about fresh meat and gnawing bones. It fights with Sunder Armor.
A Rot Hide Plague Weaver is an undead creature that snarls about fresh meat and gnawing bones. Its combat role is marked by Plague Cloud.
A Rot Hide Savage is an undead creature whose snarls promise fresh meat and bones to gnaw. In combat it can use Savage Rage and Curse of Thule.
A Raging Rot Hide is an undead creature that growls, threatens to take fresh meat, and speaks of gnawing bones. Its combat ability includes Curse of Thule.

A Rot Hide Bruiser is an undead creature and a powerful member of its kind. When badly hurt, it can flee to call for assistance, showing a survival instinct that distinguishes it from a purely relentless attacker.

Thule Ravenclaw is a former Kirin Tor mage who became a Scourge necromancer and leads the Rot Hides in attacks against the Forsaken. He was a promising mage before the war. His known magic includes Hex of Ravenclaw and Immolate, and he summons an imp and casts Demon Armor.
Snarlmane is a powerful demon who uses Rage of Thule.

Rane Yorick is a Deathstalker who reconnoitered Silverpine with his brother Quinn. After Ivar the Foul badly wounds Quinn, Rane seeks help to give him time to recover and obtain a healing potion. He also wants the Deathstalkers' report delivered to High Executor Hadrec, and feared teammate Erland was lost before greeting him on his return.
Quinn Yorick is a Deathstalker recovering from Ivar the Foul’s attack. He says he has been better, accepts a potion, and expects to be able to travel soon; he thanks the person who brought it.

High Executor Hadrec is a Forsaken commander at the Sepulcher who directs operations against the Scourge and other threats in Silverpine. He assigns missions, including the assaults on the Dead Fields and Fenris Isle, and receives reports on their results and on Deathstalker reconnaissance.
Lake Creeper is a beast found in Silverpine Forest. In combat, it uses Moss Covered Feet.
Elder Lake Creeper is an older Lake Creeper found in Silverpine Forest. It uses Moss Covered Feet and Entangling Roots in combat.
Vile Fin Shorecreeper is a humanoid shore creature found in Silverpine Forest. It attacks with Gouge and Backstab.
Vile Fin Tidecaller is a humanoid caster found in Silverpine Forest and Alterac Mountains. It uses Frost Nova in combat.
Ivar the Foul is a named undead fighter encountered in Silverpine Forest.
Grimson the Pale is a named humanoid encountered in Tirisfal Glades.

A Ravenclaw Guardian is one of the undead forces named in Shadow Priest Allister’s report about a group preparing an attack near the Sepulcher. Allister directs the player to find and defeat the group.

A Ravenclaw Drudger is one of the undead forces named in Shadow Priest Allister’s report about a group preparing an attack near the Sepulcher. Allister directs the player to find and defeat the group.

Deathstalker Erland fears the wolves outside his refuge and asks for help reaching his teammate, Rane Yorick. Along the way, he warns about wolves hiding among the trees. After reaching Rane, Erland reports wolves massing east and says the orchard’s residents are gone; he then checks on injured Quinn and gently scolds him for taking risks.

High Executor Hadrec describes Nightlash as a banshee whose magic has driven back assaults on the Rot Hides’ position at the Dead Fields. Hadrec orders an attack on the gnolls to draw her out if she does not appear, seeking her destruction and the dust of her essence as proof.
A haggard refugee in Silverpine Forest, among the humanoid residents of the area.
A sickly refugee found among the region's scattered inhabitants.

Deathstalker Faerleia leads an ambush on the Pyrewood Council to weaken Arugal and help the Forsaken gain control of the town. She calls the player to prepare for the Council's return and hails the attack as a blow to Arugal, acting in service to Lady Sylvanas.

Apothecary Berard was among the Royal Apothecary Society's promising members and studied an ancient plague that killed aquatic life in Lake Lordamere. Arugal's magic cursed him into a mindless servant; the Society seeks his journal from his study at the Pyrewood Village inn.
Archmage Ataeric is a named mage whose combat abilities include Fireball, Chains of Ice and Polymorph. When badly wounded, he flees for help.

Shadow Priest Allister investigates the Dalaran wizards’ activity in Ambermill, seeking their purpose and the source of their spellcasting. He shares findings with Dalar and urges efforts to delay the wizards’ progress. His reports of undead preparing an attack near Beren’s Peril are explicitly incomplete.
Edwin Harly is a general-supplies merchant who offers goods and ammunition.
Reef Frenzy is a beast creature.
Karos Razok is a bat handler at the Sepulcher who arranges rides to the Undercity. He says his bats are well trained and fast, and handles a supply requisition carried there for the Deathguards.
The Pyrewood Armorer is a local armorer who offers goods to browse.
The Pyrewood Tailor is a local tailor who offers goods to browse. The evidence establishes this practical clothing-supply role, without giving the tailor a personal history or individual views.

The Pyrewood Leatherworker is a local leatherworker who offers goods to browse. The evidence establishes this practical leatherworking supply role, without giving the leatherworker a personal history or individual views.

Wallace the Blind is identified as a weaponsmith and offers goods to browse. His name distinguishes him from the other local craftspeople, while the available evidence gives no further personal history or views.

Patrice Dwyer supplies poison goods. Her name and poison-supplies title identify her trade; although the record also marks a questgiver option, the supplied evidence gives no quest details or personal history.
Alexandre Lefevre is a leather armor merchant, identified by his trade title and a native option to browse his goods.
Sebastian Meloche is an armorer. His native services support both vendor and repair roles.
Andrea Boynton is a clothier, with native vendor service and a matching option to browse her goods.
Johan Focht is a mining trainer, offering the native training service to visitors seeking instruction in the profession.
Andrew Hilbert is a trade supplies merchant, identified by his title and native vendor service.
Guillaume Sorouy is a blacksmithing trainer. His native trainer service is presented with a brief, impatient greeting about interruptions costing him time.
Dalaran Brewmaster is a Dalaran-named vendor who offers goods to browse.
Dalaran Miner is a Dalaran-named miner who offers goods to browse.

Dalin Forgewright is described in a warlock's account as having devoted himself to caring for Lordaeron refugees turned away by their kin at the Greymane Wall. The account names him as a target in a search for men of honor.
Killian Sanatha is identified as a fisherman and has a vendor service.
Lilly sells enchanting supplies.
Leo Sarn sells enchanting supplies.
Gwyn Farrow is a mushroom merchant whose shop offers goods to browse. Her role is practical and local: she sells mushrooms.

The Corrupt Minor Manifestation of Water is a hostile water creature in the area. Its name identifies it as a minor manifestation, setting it apart from the separately named Corrupt Water Spirits found nearby.
Corrupt Water Spirits are hostile water creatures found in the area. Their shared name and nearby presence distinguish them from the separately named minor manifestation of water.
Lake Frenzy is a lake creature found across two regions.

Deathguard Podrig handles equipment provisioning for the Sepulcher Deathguards and says they need weapons to replace losses in the field. When addressing returned supplies, he asks whether the Undercity crate has arrived; he regards the weapons as preparation against threats and a service to the Dark Lady.

Astor Hadren is a messenger who travels between Silverpine and the Undercity. He says he is running late for an employer who dislikes tardiness; the Deathstalkers seek his letter of introduction. When someone identifies him by name, he attacks.

Lord Varimathras considers Fenwick Thatros a threat to the Forsaken and believes he leads undead who have taken root in Silverpine Forest. Deathstalker reports placed Fenwick near a decrepit dock on Lordamere.

Innkeeper Bates is an innkeeper who offers weary travelers a place to rest, can make the inn their home, and sells goods. The seasonal Trick or Treat interaction adds a holiday service to his usual inn duties.

Tiev Mordune has defeated the corrupt water spirit and is preparing the ritual materials at a brazier. After hearing of someone who failed to reach the spirit in time, he offers help with another attempt: he knows how the Water Sapta works and offers to accompany the visitor to the shrine to speak with the pure spirit.
A Silverpine Deathguard is a humanoid guard stationed in Silverpine Forest.

Mura Runetotem came to Silverpine to aid her undead allies and hoped to bring new life to its ailing forest. She marvels at the lingering life in a shell from the Barrens and plans to study it for clues that could help heal the land.
Nadia Vernon is a bowyer who sells goods and ammunition.
Sarah Goode is a stable master who helps stable pets and recover lost companions.
Gorefang is a hostile elite beast that uses a spell in combat.
Old Vicejaw is a hostile elite beast.
Krethis Shadowspinner is a humanoid creature that fights with spells, casting when combat begins and as it continues.
Elder Obsidian speaks of the new-year moon as the time when the ancients awake, and regards homage to the old races warmly.

Advisor Sorrelon serves as a resource of advice for the High Executor at the Sepulcher, hoping to strengthen the Horde and turn back the Scourge. He represents sin’dorei interests among the Forsaken, yet finds the place unsettling and regards its residents with unease. He urges blood elf visitors to protect the new bond with the Horde through careful conduct.

The Silverpine Forest Flame Keeper represents the Horde festival flame in Silverpine, welcoming visitors who come to honor it. The keeper encourages honoring Horde fires and desecrating Alliance fires.
Prince Atherann is a San'layn prince involved in an Arugal-related event in Silverpine Forest.
Prince Keleseth is a San'layn prince in Silverpine Forest.
Prince Valanar is a San'layn prince in Silverpine Forest who calls on the Lich King's power to command Arugal to rise.
An undead shade of Arugal.

Prince Theraldis is a San'layn in Silverpine. He approves a captive as suitable and says they should be sent to Solstice Village when ready, warning that Arthas will not be pleased if the work falls behind schedule.

place_records.text: You are in Silverpine Forest, Horde land in the Eastern Kingdoms. Its main settlement is The Sepulcher, a Horde base, while Alliance folk keep watch in Pyrewood Village and Dalaran's wizards are active in the north. Grizzled bears and worgs roam the woods, rot hide gnolls and Ravenclaw raiders are a constant trouble, and the Scourge has made a hive of the Decrepit Ferry.

You are in Fenris Isle, an island in Silverpine Forest that the Scourge uses as its place of strength. Rot Hide brutes, plague weavers and raging rot hides patrol it, and Vile Fin lakestalkers and lake skulkers are among its hostile creatures.

You are in Pyrewood Village, a village in Silverpine Forest where Alliance watchers and sentries keep watch. Arugal uses the Pyrewood Council as his puppets, and the Deathstalker Faerleia plans an ambush on the Council to weaken Arugal and help the Forsaken take the town.
You are in Deep Elem Mine, a mine in Silverpine Forest where Moonrage gluttons and Moonrage darksouls are found, with grizzled bears in the area.
You are in The Skittering Dark, an area of Silverpine Forest where moss stalkers and mist creepers lurk and giant grizzled bears roam. Sons of Arugal are among its dangers.
You are in Valgan's Field, an area of Silverpine Forest where Moonrage whitescalps and darkrunners roam, along with Vile Fin shredders and tidehunters.

You are in The Sepulcher, a Horde base in Silverpine Forest run by the Forsaken. High Executor Hadrec directs operations against the Scourge and other threats in the forest from here, and Apothecary Renferrel of the Royal Apothecary Society studies rot hide ichor. Karos Razok arranges bat rides to the Undercity, and the flight master, inn and armorers serve travelers.
You are in Olsen's Farthing, an area of Silverpine Forest where Ravenclaw raiders and Ravenclaw slaves are the hostile presence.

You are in The Greymane Wall, a barrier in Silverpine Forest where Lordaeron refugees have been turned away by their own kin. Dalin Forgewright cares for them, and Wallace the Blind, a weaponsmith, works here. Bloodsnout worgs and Moonrage bloodhowlers are hostile.
You are in Beren's Peril, a place in Silverpine Forest where Dalaran watchers, wizards and mages keep an Alliance presence. Ravenclaw guardians and drudgers are hostile here.
You are in The Dawning Isles, a set of isles in Silverpine Forest where Vile Fin tidecallers and oracles are the hostile presence, with lake creepers and Vile Fin shorecreepers also about.

You are in Ambermill, where Dalaran's mages, protectors and warders are stationed among the Alliance folk. Archmage Ataeric is a named mage here, and the Horde shadow priest Allister investigates the Dalaran wizards' activity in the area. Ravenclaw guardians and drudgers are hostile.

You are in The Decrepit Ferry, a ferry east of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest that the Scourge has made a hive. Rot hides and other undead patrol it, and Ravenclaw champions and the Hand of Ravenclaw are hostile here.
You are in Malden's Orchard, an orchard in Silverpine Forest. Deathstalker Erland is holed up here, afraid of the wolves outside, and worgs roam the trees with a worg called Gorefang among them.

You are in The Ivar Patch, a farm in Silverpine Forest. Deathstalker brothers Rane and Quinn Yorick are here, and Quinn is still recovering from wounds the ghoul Ivar the Foul gave him, with Ivar usually lurking in the barn. Ravenclaw slaves, grizzled bears and worgs roam the fields around them.
You are in The Dead Field, an open stretch of Silverpine Forest with no settlement. Rot Hide gladerunners and mystics roam it with grizzled bears and worgs, and a nightlash is reported here too.

You are in North Tide's Run, a shoreline in Silverpine Forest where Horde folk work and a vendor trades. Tiev Mordune has just defeated a corrupt water spirit here and is preparing ritual materials at a brazier. Fisherman Killian Sanatha works nearby, and corrupt water spirits and reef frenzies haunt the water.
You are in South Tide's Run, a stretch of shoreline in Silverpine Forest. Reef frenzies prowl the water here.

You are in The Shining Strand, a Horde place in Silverpine Forest. A Kor'kron overseer watches the Forsaken and apothecaries here, mistrusting both since the Wrath Gate, and a royal dreadguard is also on hand. Vile fin shredders and tidehunters roam the area with worgs.
You are in North Tide's Hollow, a place in Silverpine Forest. Moonrage gluttons are common here, and moonrage darksouls roam with them.

You are in Lordamere Lake, a lake in Silverpine Forest where Horde folk gather. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen who rules the Forsaken, is among them, and Champion Cyssa Dawnrose, a paladin trainer, is here. Lake frenzies and vile fin shredders, lakestalkers and tidehunters make the water dangerous.
